title: job event: file
description: A piece of a file a vendor tool wrote on the bench host (tool-run). Files are cut into 512 KiB pieces before base64; an empty file is one frame with b64 "" and end true.

name.description: File name relative to the tool's working directory.

size.description: Total length of the file in bytes.

offset.description: Byte offset of this piece in the file.

b64.description: This piece, standard base64 with padding.

end.description: True on the last piece of this file.
